body:
Follow-up to `robofab-scurvefine` (its first next step): re-solves the time-optimal carry at 400/1600/6400 nodes in all 12 speed-limited rows. Converged edge over the ramp-resolved trapezoid is +0.11 to +0.88% in every row (negative in 7 rows at 400 nodes). Stylised; 47 tests; `python site/build.py` prints ok.

Also checked the queue: no open PRs; stranded branches `selfrep-termsat` duplicates `selfrep-terminalmarket` and `garment-twonodegate` already exists on main, so both were left unmerged.
